Battle Axe Records is an independent record label based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.  It was formed by Shane Bunting (Madchild of Swollen Members) in 1996. The label was distributed by Nettwerk in Canada and Caroline in the United States from 1999 to 2005.
